name: microRNA 143

function.text: MIR143 encodes a microRNA precursor. The mature microRNA participates in post-transcriptional regulation of target transcripts through effects on mRNA stability and translation.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Glomus tumor, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: MIR143 encodes a microRNA precursor rather than a protein. MicroRNA production involves sequential processing of a primary transcript by DROSHA and DICER, followed by incorporation of the mature small RNA into a silencing complex. Base pairing with target messenger RNAs can reduce their translation or stability. The RefSeq record represents the precursor stem-loop, distinguishing the genomic precursor from the mature regulatory RNA.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving MIR143 have been reported in glomus tumor, malignant.
